title: US-open breakout day trading with 3x Nasdaq-100 ETPs (LQQ3/LQQS)
agenda_item: Owner request: day trading with leveraged funds
hypothesis: A mechanical US-open opening-range breakout, traded long/short with 3x Nasdaq ETPs during the LSE/US overlap, beats holding.
rationale: Mechanical stand-in for discretionary intraday index trading as practised by retail day traders; opening-range momentum is a documented intraday pattern.
data: Yahoo 5-minute bars: QQQ (signal), LQQ3.L and LQQS.L (fills), last ~60 days
methodology: Range = first 15 or 30 min after 09:30 NY; first 5m close beyond range -> 3x long/short ETP; stop on close back beyond the opposite side; flat by 15:25 London; one trade per day.
benchmark: holding LQQ3 over the same window; cash
costs: 0.15% per side (base), 0.30% (stress); no commission on Trading 212; GBX lines so no FX fee
limitations: ~40 trading days only: cannot prove or disprove an edge
5-minute closes, not tick fills; real spreads on 3x ETPs vary
LSE/US overlap is only ~2 hours a day
a discretionary trader's rules cannot be reproduced exactly
decision_detail: Lost money in every variant over the sample, while simply holding LQQ3 gained; most trades were small losses eaten by spread.
